inputText: This is Resh — RESH. Sound: a soft back-of-throat R, like a French r. Shape hook: rounded bent pipe. Tip: Curved shoulder has no sharp Dalet corner or protruding straight roof; do not mix it up with Dalet, Final Kaf.
